comments.author: Armie
comments.body:
very useful if you for grinding and fleet battle. less useful in single pvp, or if u use galleys.

If the main sail (the one on middle mast) is broken, your ship speed will be reduced by nearly 50%. You would not have the luxury to use spare sails in the middle of a cannon fight since u will be spamming repair and vigor food. and slowing down 50% means u will miss tactic opportunities or even worse being crit hit.

I would personally sacrifice the +10% melee atk bonus with this skill. Thus i would still have two melee +atk/def skills (25% bonus in total), a R4 cannon skill, plus this one.
